_doc: Session 14 word pass 2: words BlasterAI 60 needs that have no art yet, collected while clustering Social and Feelings against Avaz (Mark 2026-10-27). 'pages' is ready for tools/apply_word_pass.py once the art exists. Social, Feelings and Questions are laid out by `at` rows, so apply_word_pass's append would land a word in the empty column 5: after applying, move each word to its 'cell' in that page's `at` instead. 'waitingForRoom' are words the page has no cell for yet; each needs a cell freed (or a folder) before it is applied.

waitingForRoom._why: Social's 40 cells are full. 'problem' is drawn as a problem (a broken toy), not Avaz's 'no problem'. Moving the reactions (awesome, cool, great, funny, oh, oh my, uh oh, no way) into a folder beside Sounds would make room.
Feelings' 40 cells are full: two blocks of four either side of column 5.
